test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The minor project put forward by the government __is now moving around into__ its third year.
solution:
The correct answer is "**is now moving into**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Around**" means "**to various places**".
 
• **"Moving** **around" **means **going to various places**. 
 
 
• **Example**: *The Evans are **moving around** India for Summer vacation. *
 
 
 
• "**Moving into**" means "**entering into**".
 
 
• **Example: ***We will be **moving into** our new flat within a month. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate option is "is now moving into".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see some phrasal verbs beginning with "**move**". 
 
• **Moving along** - progressing or developing.
 
 
• **Example:** *I am **moving along** the story.*
 
 
 
• **Moving at** - set into motion.
 
 
• **Example:** *The train is **moving at** a speed of 100kmph. *
 
 
 
• **Moving on **- going forward
 
 
• **Example:** *Rin needs to **move on** from his current job. *
 
 
 
• **move over** - go aside.
 
 
• **Example**:* I want to sit here. Please **move over. ***
